item.title: Bayesian Prediction of Antiretroviral Therapy Switching Due to Viral Rebound
item.description:
Overview A probabilistic framework predicting the likelihood and timing of virologic failure in patients on long-term ART.

Problem Motivation Late detection of viral rebound leads to irreversible immune system damage and increased transmission risk.

Methodology Leveraged longitudinal viral load monitoring data to train a hierarchical Bayesian joint model.

Key Findings The model successfully flagged imminent viral rebound an average of 3 months earlier than standard threshold-based alarms.
